description: Checks the brain: questions whose answers are only in the notes, one Stand already knows, and one that is nowhere. Run with STAND_CONTEXT=poc/heckler/context and --talk poc/heckler/short-talk.md.

during.label: fact from the notes, mid-talk
during.say: Sorry to interrupt, but how many people attended the Tuesday pilot?

after.label: something it already knows
after.say: Where does the name Stand come from?

after.label: fact that is nowhere
after.say: What was the budget for the pilot?

goodbye.label: goodbye
goodbye.say: No more questions from us. Thank you.
